mobs.name: Regolith Crawler
mobs.behavior: Burrows under Regolith and waits; lunges when a player walks within 3 blocks
mobs.drops_text: Crawler Leg 0–2, Regolith Dust 1–3, rare Selenite shard
design_notes: Burrowed state: only the dust plates and eyes show above the block surface.
Eyes on the emissive layer.
Walk cycle: legs alternate in two sets of three.
goals_in_priority_order: BurrowAmbushGoal (custom): burrow when no target, wait
mechanics: While burrowed: invisible except dust plates + eyes (model bone visibility), no collision push, takes 50% less damage
Emerges when a player is within 3 blocks and not sneaking
Hit applies Slowness I 60 ticks

mobs.name: Rust Beetle
mobs.java_base: Animal + NeutralMob (tameable, saddle + chest like a llama)
mobs.behavior: Grazes on Rust Lichen; rams back when hit; tamed beetles with a Ferrox saddle carry a chest
mobs.drops_text: Beetle Grub 0–1, Ferrox bits 1–2, Rust Shell (armor upgrade)
design_notes: Shell splits open when it flies short hops (low gravity).
Spots use the shell spot color.
mechanics: Low-gravity hop: occasional jump with shell-open animation
Tame with Rust Lichen; Ferrox saddle (new item) + chest gives 15-slot storage

mobs.name: Crystal Stag
mobs.behavior: Shear the antlers for 1–2 Starlite; they regrow over 5 minutes. Breeds with Starbloom
mobs.spawns_text: Cerulon Azure Moss plains, herds of 3–5
design_notes: Sheared state: antlers shrink to stubs; glow turns off.
Antlers, eyes on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Shears: drop 1-2 starlite, set SHEARED synced data, regrow after 6000 ticks
Sheared: antler bones hidden, glowmask off

mobs.name: Prismling
mobs.behavior: Swarms in groups; shatters into 2–3 crystal shards on death that deal 1 damage nearby
design_notes: Name changed: "Shardling" is already the minion line in Shattered Skies.
Core pulses on the emissive layer.
mechanics: On death: spawn 2-3 shard particles/projectiles dealing 1 damage within 2 blocks
Spawns in geodes and crystal caves (low light)

mobs.name: Cinder Hound
mobs.damage_text: 4, sets target on fire for 2 s
mobs.behavior: Hunts in packs of 3–5; circles, then lunges together. Immune to fire
design_notes: Ember cracks and tail on the emissive layer.
Leaves a short ember particle trail when running.
goals_in_priority_order: PackCircleGoal (custom): circle target at 5 blocks until 3+ pack members ready
mechanics: fireImmune() in EntityType builder
Bite: target.igniteForSeconds(2)
Ember particle trail while sprinting

mobs.name: Frost Warden
mobs.behavior: Guards the largest wrecks. Phase 2 at half health: summons 2 Rime Stalkers and an ice wall ring
mobs.spawns_text: One per large wreck on Eidolon; does not respawn
mobs.drops_text: Wraithsteel Ingots 3–5, Frost Warden Helm (trophy), Remnant Shard
design_notes: Visor, core, antler-like pauldron tips and glaive edge on the emissive layer.
Boss bar in pale cyan.
goals_in_priority_order: IceWallRingGoal (phase 2: ring of glacial_ice radius 6, melts after 200t)
mechanics: Placed by wreck structure; persistenceRequired, no natural respawn
Boss bar only within 32 blocks

mobs.name: Flare Sprite
mobs.damage_text: 3 fire, or a small fireball at range
mobs.behavior: Swarms around Flare Vents; bursts into flame when a vent erupts. Water puts it out instantly
mobs.spawns_text: Solvane near Flare Vents, swarms of 4–8
design_notes: Whole mob is emissive; no shadow.
Animated wing flicker (4 frames).
mechanics: Dies instantly in water or rain (isInWaterRainOrBubble -> kill)
Whole model fullbright, no shadow (shadowRadius 0)
Near erupting vent: +50% damage for 100t

mobs.name: Sun Colossus
mobs.damage_text: 14 slam; ground wave sets fire in a line
mobs.behavior: Wakes when a player steps on its Sunspot Rock plateau. Core opens to take damage after each slam
mobs.drops_text: Astrium 4–6, Coronite 6–10, Colossus Core (Fusion Reactor upgrade)
design_notes: Core only takes damage while open (animated plates).
Cracks, core, vents on the emissive layer.
goals_in_priority_order: SlamGoal (custom: 14 dmg AoE + fire line ground wave)
DormantUntilTriggeredGoal (custom: wake when player on plateau)
mechanics: Invulnerable except during core_open window (hurt() returns false otherwise)
Drops colossus_core (fusion_reactor upgrade)

mobs.name: Dune Burrower
mobs.damage_text: 8; can swallow and hold a player for 2 s
mobs.behavior: Travels under sand shown as a moving ripple; bursts up under players who stand still
mobs.drops_text: Burrower Steak 1–3, Burrower Scale, Star Map Fragment (rare)
design_notes: Colors tinted per galaxy like the terrain.
Underground: only a sand ripple particle trail.
goals_in_priority_order: BurrowTravelGoal (custom: move under sand, ripple particles)
mechanics: While burrowed: noPhysics through sand-tagged blocks, invisible, ripple particles
Swallow: player riding mob, invisible, 2 dmg/s for 2 s

mobs.name: Ash Strider
mobs.behavior: Wades across lava lakes; rideable with a saddle, making it the lava crossing mount
design_notes: Vents on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Walks on lava: canStandOnFluid(lava) = true (copy Strider)
Rideable with saddle; steer with a cinder_cap on a stick is optional

mobs.name: Rime Stalker
mobs.behavior: Stalks from behind; only visible within 8 blocks during blizzards
mobs.spawns_text: Frozen wastelands; summoned by the Frost Warden
design_notes: Spines on the emissive layer.
goals_in_priority_order: StalkFromBehindGoal (custom: approach outside player view cone)
mechanics: During snowfall: invisible to players more than 8 blocks away (client-side render check)
Hit adds 100 frozen ticks (setTicksFrozen)

mobs.name: Bog Lurker
mobs.behavior: Lies submerged in Acid with only eyes showing
design_notes: Sacs and eyes on the emissive layer.
goals_in_priority_order: SubmergeGoal (custom: sit in acid with eyes above surface)
mechanics: Speed x2.5 while in zerog_tweaks:acid fluid
Immune to acid damage type

mobs.name: Crater Drifter
mobs.behavior: Floats over craters; drops Meteorite Fragments as it drifts. Attacking one makes nearby drifters swarm
design_notes: Fissure on the emissive layer.
Bobs up and down (2 s cycle).
goals_in_priority_order: DriftGoal (custom: random float 4-10 blocks above ground)
mechanics: No gravity (setNoGravity); bob 2 s cycle in animation only

mobs.name: Prism Sentinel
mobs.behavior: 1: beams bounce off the orbiting shards. 2: shards break loose and circle the arena. 3: core cracks open, and hits to the heart light deal double
mobs.spawns_text: Crystal amphitheater on Galaxy 2's key world
mobs.drops_text: Galaxy 3 gate key, Cerulite 4–6, Sentinel Prism (T3 lens upgrade)
design_notes: Shards orbit on a 4 s loop around the core.
Core and shards on the emissive layer; boss bar cyan.
Test, not a hunt: Opens by asking "Are you Concord?" in the chat; beaten, it names you an heir
goals_in_priority_order: BeamAttackGoal (custom: 10 dmg beams reflecting off orbiting shards)
states: phase3 core open (x2 damage to heart)

transitions.to: phase3 core open (x2 damage to heart)

transitions.frm: phase3 core open (x2 damage to heart)

mechanics: Phase thresholds 66% / 33%
Chat line on start and on defeat (translatable)
Drops galaxy_3_gate_key, cerulite 4-6, sentinel_prism, cerulite template

mobs.name: Rift Tyrant
mobs.damage_text: Claw 16; rift pull drags you toward the rift
mobs.behavior: 1: charges and claws. 2: rift pulls chunks of the arena into the void. 3: spines fire void shards
mobs.spawns_text: Fractured island over the void on Galaxy 3's key world
mobs.drops_text: Galaxy 4 gate key, Skarnite 4–6, Rift Heart
design_notes: Arena blocks near the rift fall away over the fight.
Cracks, spines and eyes on the emissive layer; boss bar violet.
Lore: Vael's lieutenant, fused into the rift he helped tear open
goals_in_priority_order: RiftPullGoal (pull players toward rift, remove arena blocks)
mechanics: Arena block removal: only blocks tagged zerog_tweaks:rift_arena (new tag), restore on reset
Void damage type zerog_tweaks:void_rift for pull-into-void

mobs.name: Eidolon Captain
mobs.behavior: 1: duels with the cutlass. 2: calls Hollow Crewmen. 3: fleet lantern freezes the deck
mobs.spawns_text: Flagship deck on Galaxy 4's key world
mobs.drops_text: Galaxy 5 gate key, Eidolite 4–6; Captain's Lantern if spared
design_notes: Whole body at 80% opacity; legs fade to 40%.
Eyes, lantern and blade on the emissive layer; boss bar pale blue.
Peaceful ending: Show him the crew's final log (enough Remnant Shards) and he yields without a fight
goals_in_priority_order: SummonCrewGoal (phase 2: Hollow Crewmen = new entity or Shattered Skies Hollow Sentinel)

transitions.trigger: player attacks / enters deck without shards

mechanics: Right-click with >= 16 remnant_shard before combat: peaceful path, drops key + captains_lantern
Render at 80% alpha, legs 40% (translucent render type)

mobs.name: The Dying Star
mobs.behavior: 1: Vael fights from the surface. 2: corona rays sweep the arena. 3: the star collapses, the core opens and the arena shrinks
mobs.drops_text: Heart of Solvane, Solvanite 6–8, T6 crown
design_notes: Rays rotate slowly; the body pulses brighter as health drops.
Everything but Vael emissive; boss bar gold to white.
Ending: Heart of Solvane drops; each player chooses Rekindle or Let it fade
mechanics: Drops heart_of_solvane; each player chooses Rekindle / Let it fade (Codex screen)
Brightness pulse scales with missing health

mobs.name: Moon Hopper
mobs.behavior: Hops up to 4 blocks high in Moon gravity; flees when hit
design_notes: Jump animation: hind feet stretch, ears fold back.
Eyes on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Jump power scaled so it clears ~4 blocks at Moon gravity (0.5x)
No fall damage (causeFallDamage returns false)

mobs.name: Dust Grazer
mobs.behavior: Grazes in herds; the whole herd stampedes if one is hit
design_notes: Mane sways in dust storms.
goals_in_priority_order: StampedeGoal (custom: when one is hurt, herd within 12 panics in the same direction)
mechanics: Stampede: entities in the herd trample (1 dmg) anything they run through
Mane sway animation driven by dust-storm weather flag

mobs.name: Azure Fowl
mobs.behavior: Glides slowly when falling; lays a Blue Egg every 5–10 minutes
mobs.spawns_text: Cerulon moss plains and Shardwood forests
design_notes: Crest on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Slow fall like a chicken (cap downward velocity at -0.1 while not on ground)
Lays blue_egg every 6000-12000 ticks (Chicken eggTime pattern)

mobs.name: Glimmerfish
mobs.behavior: Schools of 4–8; lights the water around it at night
design_notes: Scales and fins on the emissive layer.
Catching: Bucket, or fishing on Cerulon
mechanics: Bucketable: glimmerfish_bucket (new item)
At night: emits light via client dynamic light is not vanilla; approximate with glowmask + particles

mobs.name: Slag Boar
mobs.behavior: Roots through Slag; charges if hit or if you get too close to its young
design_notes: Ember tail and eyes on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Charge deals 6 + knockback 1.5
Angers when a player comes within 4 blocks of its baby

mobs.name: Scorch Wyrmling
mobs.damage_text: 3 bite; spits a fire bolt (3 + fire)
mobs.behavior: Glides between ledges; guards Emberite veins
design_notes: Flame tip and eyes on the emissive layer.
Wings flap only when gliding.
mechanics: Fire bolt: SmallFireball-like projectile (3 dmg + fire)
Glide: slow fall + forward motion when jumping off ledges

mobs.name: Frost Yak
mobs.behavior: Shear for Yak Wool; milk with a glass bottle for Frost Milk. Shelters calves in blizzards
design_notes: Sheared state: wool shrinks to a thin coat.
mechanics: Shears -> yak_wool 1-2; regrows after eating a snowpack/frozen_regolith block
Glass bottle -> frost_milk (see ZGInteractions)

mobs.name: Ice Leech
mobs.damage_text: 2 and latches on: Hunger II while attached
mobs.behavior: Hides under Snowpack; shake it off by sprinting or hitting it
design_notes: Body at 75% opacity.
Crystals on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Latch: startRiding(player), apply Hunger II while attached
Detach when rider sprints 20 ticks or leech is hit

mobs.name: Gildcrab
mobs.behavior: Walks sideways; basks on Sunspot Rock and is immune to heat
design_notes: Eyes on the emissive layer.
mechanics: Moves sideways: rotate body 90 degrees from travel direction
Immune to corona_crust/ember_crust damage types

mobs.name: Deep Eel
mobs.behavior: Lurks in trenches; follows light sources
design_notes: Fin ridge and eyes on the emissive layer.
goals_in_priority_order: FollowLightSourceGoal (custom: move toward block light > 10 or player holding light)

transitions.trigger: light source > 10 or player with light

mechanics: Bite pulls target down: target.push(0,-0.6,0)
Out of water: flop and take suffocation damage like fish

mobs.name: Sand Skitter
mobs.behavior: Buries itself in Dunesand; bursts out in groups of 2–3
mobs.drops_text: Skitter Leg 1–2, Skitter Carapace 0–1, Venom Gland 0–1
design_notes: Stinger and eyes on the emissive layer.
goals_in_priority_order: BuriedAmbushGoal (custom: bury in dunesand, burst in 2-3)

transitions.trigger: player within 4 or group member bursts

mechanics: Sting: Poison I 80t
Wake one buried skitter triggers the group within 8 blocks
